topic: Why people who pay their credit-card bill on time still get into money trouble
central_idea: Paying only the minimum due, on time, ends the interest-free period for the unpaid balance and every new purchase, because interest-free credit is a reward for paying in full, not for meeting the due date.
engagement_goal: Saves and shares from cardholders who habitually pay only the minimum due; comments from people surprised by past interest charges
